bringup-o.id-register-s: 9Fh Read JEDEC ID (MF7-0, ID15-8, ID7-0); also ABh Device ID, 90h Manufacturer/Device ID
bringup-o.id-expect-s: 9Fh: EFh 60h 18h (Winbond EFh, W25Q128JW-IQ/JQ device ID 6018h); ABh/90h device ID 17h
bringup-o.check-s: 05h Read Status Register-1: BUSY (S0) = 0 when idle; 35h Status Register-2: QE = 1 (factory-fixed default for IQ/JQ ordering options)
bringup-o.source-s: W25Q128JW datasheet Rev E: 8.1 Manufacturer and Device Identification table p21 (pdf p22); Instruction Set Table 1 p22; Read JEDEC ID (9Fh) p49; QE bit description p16; ordering W25Q128JWSIQ p75

component-o.description-s: 128 Mbit 1.8 V serial NOR flash, standard / dual / quad SPI, 133 MHz, 1.7 V to 1.95 V, -40 to 85 °C, SOIC-8 208 mil. The 100 nF VCC decoupling in stdpins-ao is common practice, not a datasheet value

cfgpins-ao.1c: /CS must track VCC at power-up and power-down; the datasheet says a pull-up resistor on /CS can be used for this (section 6.5 write protection). Value not given, 10k used.

cfgpins-ao.3c: Write protect in standard / dual SPI, IO2 in quad SPI (QE = 1). Wire to the host's IO2.

cfgpins-ao.7c: Hold or reset in standard / dual SPI, IO3 in quad SPI (QE = 1). Wire to the host's IO3.

step_source-o.derived: operating max 20 mA (ICC3 quad read 104 MHz / ICC4-7 write, program, erase) less the smallest low-power current 1 uA typ (ICC2 power-down, 85 C)
